cases.blind_review_reason: No correction at all. Four protocol-declared outcomes judged at unadjusted 0.05; FEV1 (p=0.0179) and CRP (p=0.0228) would not survive any family adjustment.
No correction at all. Six declared outcomes each get a two-sample t-test judged at unadjusted 0.05, with four called significant across the family.
No correction at all. All three protocol-declared outcomes are tested and called at an unadjusted 0.05, justified only by calling each outcome a separate question.
No correction at all. Five declared outcomes each judged at unadjusted 0.05; faecal cortisol (p=0.0140) and body condition (p=0.0039) rest on that uncorrected threshold.
Partial correction. Holm covers only the two primary endpoints; the remaining five of seven declared outcomes are decided on raw p at 0.05, four of them called significant that way.
Partial correction. Only the three headline yield outcomes get a Bonferroni multiplier; the other five of eight declared outcomes are judged on raw p at 0.05, including soluble solids at p=0.0489.
All five declared p-values passed in one call to statsmodels multipletests, whose default Holm-Sidak method controls family-wise error; verdicts taken from adjusted values.
Sidak correction over the declared family of four, threshold derived as 1-(0.95)^(1/4)=0.012741; turbidity at p=0.027 is correctly not called significant.
All four declared outcomes corrected together with Holm step-down via pingouin.multicomp at family alpha 0.05; every verdict read from adjusted p-values.
All four declared outcomes Holm-adjusted together in one pass at family alpha 0.05. The suspended-solids re-run is an explicitly non-inferential sensitivity check with no verdict.
Discovery/validation split fixed before measurement. Discovery p-values are screening only; the four carried-forward outcomes are confirmed in the validation half at Bonferroni 0.05/4 = 0.0125.
Gatekeeping design. A single pre-specified family-level screen on the root-mean-square standardised separation, cutoff fixed in advance, controls entry to any per-outcome testing.
Correction performed upstream. Verdicts read from supplied Holm-adjusted p-values covering all four declared outcomes; the arithmetic in the supplied table checks out.
Permutation-based family-wise control. One shared label shuffle per round, max absolute Welch t across the five outcomes, 5000 rounds, verdicts against the family-maximum reference.
Pre-registered corrected threshold. Protocol fixed per-outcome alpha at 0.01, which is 0.05 divided by the five declared outcomes; every outcome judged against it.
